en.title: Mississippi Midterm Accessibility Focus Highlights Policy Gaps and Advocacy Calls
en.summary: Accessibility cannot be an afterthought in Mississippi’s midterm elections, highlighting policy gaps. Meanwhile, Trinity campus construction expands accessibility features, a family donated an adaptive hiking wheelchair to a state park, and a survey shows AI’s potential to improve workplace and learning accessibility. Additionally, X platform offers a guide to disable video autoplay, and advocates raise concerns over limited disaster relief for people with developmental disabilities.

highlights.title: Accessibility Cannot Be an Afterthought in Mississippi’s Midterm
Construction Underway On Trinity To Expand Accessibility For All
Family donates adaptive hiking wheelchair to local state park for better accessibility
Survey highlights AI's potential to advance accessibility in work and learning
Concerns Over Support for People with Developmental Disabilities

zh-TW.title: 密西西比州中期選舉凸顯無障礙政策缺口與社會關注
zh-TW.summary: 密西西比州中期選舉凸顯無障礙政策缺點，強調無障礙不得成為事後補救。三一校園正進行擴建無障礙設施工程，一家人捐贈適應性登山輪椅給州立公園，且最新調查顯示人工智慧在工作與學習中的無障礙潛力。此外，X平台提供關閉影片自動播放的實用指南，同時有使用者對發展障礙者災害救助僅限特定組織表示擔憂。

highlights.title: 無障礙不得成為密西西比州中期選舉的事後補救
三一建設工程進行中，以擴大無障礙設施惠及所有人
家庭捐贈適應性登山輪椅給州立公園以提升無障礙性
調查顯示人工智慧有潛力提升工作與學習中的無障礙性
對發展障礙者支援措施之疑慮
